title: Maximum three-SAT template
statement: The maximum three-SAT template has Boolean values and a finite family of allowed predicates. Each predicate has arity one more than the natural number in the first component of its label, and its evaluation is given by the corresponding maximum three-SAT predicate evaluation.
caveat: The payload does not define the predicate labels or their evaluator, so their precise mathematical meaning cannot be stated from the supplied information.
